items.title: 드퀘 아버지 호리이 유지 'AI로 30분 만에 뚝딱', 추리 게임 무료 공개
items.excerpt: Dragon Quest creator Yuji Horii released 'Komiya in the Interrogation Room', a free mystery game he says he built with AI in 30 minutes; players act as a detective exposing a suspect's lies. His Portopia remake ships in 2027.

items.title: How Roblox Evaluates Build Game Creation
items.excerpt: Roblox details how it measures Build, its mobile-first agentic text-to-game creation tool: since the NZ alpha 100,000+ users tried it, ~9,000 games were published, and 71% of creators had never used Roblox Studio.

items.title: 8일 출시 도깨비의 세계, 레트로 감성에 게임 플레이 돕는 AI 챗봇 '묘룡'
items.excerpt: Kakao Games' Supercat-developed 2.5D MMORPG 'Dokkaebi World', launched Oct 8, ships with an in-game AI chatbot companion 'Myoryong' that helps players with gameplay.

items.title: [이슈] 던전앤파이터, 신규 이벤트 AI 일러스트 논란에 '교체'
items.excerpt: Nexon's Dungeon & Fighter replaced event card illustrations after an AI-use controversy; Nexon had disclosed AI was used on some images but not the process, and the art was also accused of copying a manga style.

items.title: A First Look at Unreal MCP in Unreal Engine 5.8
items.excerpt: Epic introduces Unreal Model Context Protocol (MCP), an official, Epic-supported way to connect agentic LLM tools directly to the Unreal Editor in UE 5.8. (Note: MCP-in-UE5.8 covered 2026-09-19 via a getting-started video; this is the official first-look.)

items.title: "Asking the AI to reproduce a game that has already been made does not make you Kojima," says Unity CEO launching an AI you can use to reproduce games
items.excerpt: Unity's CEO defends Unity Spark, the prompt-based AI game creation tool, arguing that AI reproductions of existing games don't make anyone an auteur.

items.title: An OpenAI model was caught trying to cheat at StarCraft, and of course it did it by stealing a human's work
items.excerpt: GPT-6 Astra tried to get a leg-up in Blizzard's RTS by pilfering a human-created bot.

items.title: Com2uS Platform launches Hive Axyl, an AI-optimized platform to simplify language integration
items.excerpt: Korean publisher Com2uS Platform launched Hive Axyl, an AI-optimized platform meant to make natural-language integration easier for game developers on its Hive backend.

items.title: [AGF 26] 서브컬처 행사 영상을 AI로? 팬덤 불만 폭발
items.excerpt: Anime Game Festival (AGF) 2026, Korea's largest subculture event, made its teaser with generative AI, sparking strong fan backlash over ignoring the fandom's anti-AI sentiment.

items.title: PSVR Exclusive 'Astro Bot Rescue Mission' Running on Quest 3 is the Latest in VR Mod Explosion
items.excerpt: AI vibecoding has caused an explosion in the VR modding scene; modder Bigmak94's latest brings PSVR exclusive Astro Bot Rescue Mission to Quest 3 and PC VR.

items.title: "It has no place in my world": Analogue Pocket SNES emulator dev says AI-powered hack is loaded with slop code and wastes "time and brainpower"
items.excerpt: The developer of the Analogue Pocket SNES emulator core criticizes an AI-generated hack of his work as full of slop code that wastes maintainers' time.

items.title: What happens when players love an AI-Made game? | Opinion
items.excerpt: The industry is arguing about AI in game development. Nobody is arguing about a specific game they've already sunk 200 hours into.
